tier_reason: Upgraded from C to B. rurban/smhasher is a well-known independent suite (about 2.2k stars). Its README table and per-hash reports (doc/w1hash.txt, doc/wyhash.txt) show w1hash using fewer small-key cycles/hash than wyhash v4.2. SMHasher does not state its compiler or flags, so this is not A. The author's own README evidence is only a PNG chart with no benchmark script, which on its own would be C.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Independent rurban/smhasher: small-key average 26.85 vs 28.91 cycles/hash for wyhash v4.2 (about 7% fewer cycles, derived from page data). Per key size, 23.5-25.8 vs 27-28 cycles/hash for 1-16 byte keys (about 8-15% fewer, derived from page data). Author's README chart (Core Ultra 7 155H, clang): about 12 vs 17 units for 1-7 byte keys and 12 vs 14 for 8-16 byte keys against a single combined wyhash/rapidhash line (about 1.42x and 1.17x, derived from the chart), with a slight edge at 17-32 bytes, where XXH3 (xxh3low) is fastest. W1Hash is not faster than rapidhash v3 in SMHasher (about 20 cycles/hash at 1-16 bytes). It is also about 37% slower than wyhash in bulk throughput: 14208 vs 22640 MiB/s (derived from page data).
corrections.workload: Small-key hashing speed (1-32 byte keys, cycles/hash) and bulk throughput (262144-byte keys, MiB/s) in rurban/smhasher, alongside wyhash v4.2, rapidhash v3 and xxh3. Also the author's README chart for 1-32 byte keys against wyhash/rapidhash (one combined line), xxh3low, t1ha2_atonce and komihash.
corrections.hardware: SMHasher main table: AMD Ryzen 5 3350G, as labeled in its README. Author's chart: Intel Core Ultra 7 155H.
corrections.compiler_and_flags: SMHasher: compiler and flags not stated (built with the repo's CMake setup). Author's chart: clang on Ubuntu, flags not stated.
corrections.caveats: The author's benchmark is only a PNG chart with an unlabeled y-axis (probably cycles or ns per hash, lower is better). There is no comparison benchmark script in the repo; the Go BenchmarkHash benchmarks only w1hash itself. The chart puts wyhash and rapidhash on one line and does not say which rapidhash version. Independent SMHasher confirms the small-key win over wyhash v4.2, but shows rapidhash v3 faster at every small key size and w1hash about 37% slower than wyhash in bulk throughput. SMHasher tested the November 2024 C version; the C header has changed since only by a one-line cleanup. Output differs from wyhash. Very low visibility (4 stars).

notes: The metadata checked out: BSD-3-Clause, not a fork, not archived, 4 stars, last commit 2026-07-25, so active. The wyhash small-key claim is independently supported by SMHasher, but the rapidhash part holds only in the author's own chart and is contradicted by SMHasher's rapidhash v3 numbers. The catalog should frame this as a short-key-only win over wyhash.
